description: Predict fast-mode oral temperature aveOralF from thermal-image temperature readings and environment/patient metadata while excluding direct oral-region proxy temperatures. Profile: 1020 rows, 33 source features before manifest-level drops, regression target aveOralF, categorical Gender/Age/Ethnicity, two missing values in Distance, and many continuous thermal sensor readings.

plan_checklist.description: Plan includes inspecting schema, feature types, target distribution/range, and basic data quality before modeling.
Plan includes checking and handling missing values if present.
Plan includes identifying and encoding categorical/string features before regression.
Plan uses the task metric and an appropriate validation split or cross-validation.
Plan chooses model families suitable for the dataset size and regression feature mix.
Plan considers scaling/normalization for linear, distance-based, kernel, or neural models.

metadata.bench_preprocessing: Removed SubjectID and aveOralM so the monitor-mode oral temperature is not used as a direct feature for aveOralF.
metadata.drop_columns_rationale: T_OR1 and T_OR_Max1 are excluded at manifest level because they are oral-region temperature measurements and direct proxies for aveOralF.
